title: Multi-omics and bulk sequencing analyses reveal the roles of prognosis and immune aspects of super-enhancer-induced ZBED2 in pan-cancer.
authors: Ren, Jiao; Zhang, Na; Zhu, Luoyu; Zhang, Jinglei; Ma, Xiaolin; Zhang, Xiuxiu; Li, Jiaqiu; Cai, Jinwei
journal: Clinical & translational oncology : official publication of the Federation of Spanish Oncology Societies and of the National Cancer Institute of Mexico
one_liner_zh: 该文通过多组学和测序数据分析ZBED2在泛癌中的预后和免疫作用，虽涉及分子对接和MD模拟，但核心是临床生物标志物分析，缺乏TF-DNA结合与互作机制建模，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: ZBED2 is a member of the C2H2-zinc-finger BED-type zinc-finger protein family. However, the clinical significance and potential functions of ZBED2 in various cancers have not been systematically explored. METHODS: In this article, we comprehensively analyzed multi-omics and bulk sequencing data to explore the characteristics of ZBED2 in pan-cancer and its potential utility in cancer treatment. We investigated the expression pattern, association with prognosis, possible functions, correlation with tumor immunity, tumor-associated mutations, and drug sensitivity of ZBED2. RESULTS: ZBED2 was significantly differentially expressed in more than 60% of the cancer types (p < 0.05). High expression of ZBED2 was an independent risk factor for a poor prognosis in many cancer patients (p < 0.05 and Hazard Ratio > 1). ZBED2 functional enrichment analysis revealed that ZBED2 expression was associated with pathways, such as immune and lipid metabolism pathways. ZBED2 expression was positively correlated with a hot immune microenvironment and was significantly correlated with immunotherapy response (p < 0.05). In addition, the overexpression of ZBED2 was negatively correlated with DNA methylation. More importantly, P300-mediated super-enhancer activity drove ZBED2 expression. Finally, we used R software to screen out 16 drugs likely to bind to ZBED2 (correlation coefficients < -0.2 and p < 0.0001) and performed molecular docking, and molecular dynamics simulation for the top six drugs. CONCLUSIONS: Collectively, by bioinformatics analysis, this study regards ZBED2 as a potential diagnostic, prognostic biomarker for many cancers and a predictive biomarker for immunotherapy, providing new insights for the application of ZBED2 in tumor targeted therapy.
abstract_zh: 背景：ZBED2是C2H2锌指BED型锌指蛋白家族的一员。然而，ZBED2在多种癌症中的临床意义和潜在功能尚未被系统探索。方法：本文中，我们全面分析了多组学和批量测序数据，以探讨ZBED2在泛癌中的特征及其在癌症治疗中的潜在应用价值。我们研究了ZBED2的表达模式、与预后的关联、可能的功能、与肿瘤免疫的相关性、肿瘤相关突变以及药物敏感性。结果：ZBED2在超过60%的癌症类型中显著差异表达（p < 0.05）。ZBED2的高表达是许多癌症患者预后不良的独立风险因素（p < 0.05且风险比 > 1）。ZBED2功能富集分析显示，其表达与免疫和脂质代谢等通路相关。ZBED2表达与热肿瘤免疫微环境呈正相关，并与免疫治疗反应显著相关（p < 0.05）。此外，ZBED2的过表达与DNA甲基化呈负相关。更重要的是，P300介导的超增强子活性驱动了ZBED2的表达。最后，我们使用R软件筛选出16种可能与ZBED2结合的药物（相关系数 < -0.2且p < 0.0001），并对前六种药物进行了分子对接和分子动力学模拟。结论：总体而言，通过生物信息学分析，本研究将ZBED2视为多种癌症的潜在诊断和预后生物标志物，以及免疫治疗的预测性生物标志物，为ZBED2在肿瘤靶向治疗中的应用提供了新见解。
